name: header-metadata
title: Header metadata
summary: DOC-01's teal card plus header.contentDescription, the label a screen reader announces for the whole document.
prompt: Give my RemoteCompose card a document-level accessibility description ("Greeting card") in the header.
teaches: Describe the whole document for screen readers with header.contentDescription
Set header.profiles to 513 = ANDROIDX (0x200) | EXPERIMENTAL (0x1), the profile set the players and text expect
Keep apiLevel, width and height in the header next to the metadata

snippets.note: apiLevel 7, 300×200, profiles 513 (0x200 androidx + 0x1 experimental), contentDescription "Greeting card"
the document-level description a screen reader announces

check.describe: Renders like DOC-01; inspect_summary's header shows profiles 513 (the description is in the HEADER op, not echoed by summary). Resized (200×200, 450×160) the box still fills the document and the text stays centred.

pitfalls: header.contentDescription labels the whole document; to label one component use the semantics modifier {"semantics": {"contentDescription": "..."}} instead (see A11Y-01)
inspect_summary does not echo the description; it is stored in the HEADER op (look at the header in inspect output or the raw ops)
